name: git-runner-gist
description: 🏃 A tiny runner that moves with your GitHub activity

scripts.package: ncc build dist/main.js -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && find dist/ -type f \( -not -name 'index.js' -and -not -name 'index.js.map' -and -not -name 'licenses.txt' \) -delete
scripts.all: npm run build && npm test && npm run package
